description: Every stop served by one LA Metro route, in running order, with stop id, name, direction and service day type. AUTHORITATIVE for "which stops does route N serve" and for turning a route into stop ids you can look up with lametro_stop.

route_code.description: Route code from lametro_routes — a number for bus (e.g. "10", "720"), or a line name for rail (e.g. "Metro A-Line").
